verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Cloudflare Registrar offers free one-click DNSSEC activation for all customers, which meets the 'one-click' path of the story. Because Cloudflare is both the registrar and the required nameserver, the DS records reaching the registry is strongly implied, though never stated outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that DS records are submitted to the registry automatically, evidence of API-driven DNSSEC enablement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
